articles.title: He lives with his parents and loves Jesus. Meet Gen Alpha's new heartthrob.
articles.summary: Malachi Barton opens up about "Coven Academy" and his rise as Disney's latest heartthrob.
articles.body:
Young girls are pledging their allegiance to Malachi Barton.

I saw it with my own eyes at the Descendants/Zombies: Worlds Collide tour last summer: tweens and teens yelling "Malachi!" like their lives depended on it while waving pink American flags with his face on them. That was before he even stepped onstage.

"A couple of those, yeah," Barton tells Yahoo in our latest Generation Now interview, laughing when I mention the flags.

"Honestly, I still don't look at myself as that person," he adds.

But he is. At 19, Barton is Disney's latest heartthrob — like the Jonas Brothers and Zac Efron before him — and the company is banking on him. He's starring in a trifecta of key projects: vampire Victor in the Zombies movies and aspiring musician Fletch in the Camp Rock revival film, both on Disney Channel, and now warlock Jake in the Coven Academy series on Freeform. He's also headlining the next leg of the Descendants/Zombies/Camp Rock: Worlds Collide tour , and surprise-released his first single, "Stay for the Credits."

Malachi mania is not merely a Mouse House push. Variety honored him with its Rising Star Award at the 2026 Power of Young Hollywood event in August.

As his star soars, Barton still lives with his parents, Felicia Barton, an American Idol Season 8 alum, and tour manager Loren Barton. He says praying is his "No. 1 outlet," though he's also into surfing, urbexing (aka urban exploration), his car and watches. He surrounds himself with friends who will tell him to "get off [his] high horse."

The bigger his profile gets, the more his personal life has become part of the conversation too. And with Coven Academy premiering Oct. 1 on Freeform (Disney+ and Hulu the next day), Barton is entering yet another big chapter.

Barton seems intent on keeping one foot in normal life even as the other lands on increasingly bigger stages. Here, he talks about navigating both.

I saw full Malachi mania last summer when I took my daughter to the 'Worlds Collide' tour. I've been at this a long time, but I was stunned by the reaction your presence created. What's it like to be that person to people?

It's very weird and very crazy. I will be scrolling on TikTok and a TikTok Live will pop up and this girl will have a cardboard cutout of me behind her. And I'm like, OK, that's not weird at all, but also really cute [ laughs ].

I'm super grateful, that's all I can really say. I'm so grateful to be in a position where I can have a voice to so many young kids and be able to spread kindness and the light of Jesus in all things. Having that platform is super, super rad. I'm so grateful.

You're close with your family, and your faith is obviously important to you. How do those things keep you grounded?

Those are the two things, 100%. I have the best parents ever. Since I was a little, little dude, I've been in baseball and had outlets and other things outside of the business, because this business is crazy. So much fun [too], but it's also wild and up and down. You've got to have your other outlets. My No. 1 outlet is the man upstairs. Those are my grounding factors, for sure.

What's your living situation these days? Do you still live with your parents?

I do — I live with my parents. I love my parents. I love living with them. I bought my first house a little while ago, so that's been really, really wild. I feel like I'm never home anyway. My living situation is literally all over the place. First, we're in Vancouver [shooting Coven Academy ], next we're in New Zealand [for Zombies 5 ]. It's so cool because I get to travel around and see so many different parts of the world. But, yeah, I live with my parents, and we have my two little dogs, Artex and Ranger, and my car.

A BMW M3 . It's outside right now. It's my baby.

You graduated from high school last year. Did you have a traditional-ish school experience? Your graduation looked pretty normal.

I did online [school]. I went to a public elementary school for second and third grade, and then I did online [learning] for literally as long as I can remember. But I feel like I got the high school experience because all of my friends — my tight group of people — aren't in the business, and they were all in high school. So I was doing my school at home, but then I was going to all the football games, the homecomings, the proms, the formals. The teachers knew my name. I was kind of an honorary member of their school.

Honestly, I give a lot of [credit] to my friends because they've grounded me. If I come fresh off a set, they will check me very, very quickly and be like, "Get off your high horse." That's the best thing. So I got a little bit of high school, and my graduation was completely normal.

You experienced the gossip side of fame this summer. How do you deal with that?

I think it's always going to be there. You can't avoid it at all. People will always have an opinion, and that is how this business is. That's what you're signing up for. But the thing I remind myself is that the only opinion that matters is God's. People will continue to speculate and say certain things, and that's OK. They have freedom of speech. They can say whatever they want to. I just do my own thing: stay in my lane, stay at the beach, stay in my car and vibe out.

Your schedule this year is insane: a show, TV movies and a tour. How do you spend a day when you're off the clock?

I literally surf. I'm always in the ocean, and I love [it] so much. The ocean is the most physically and mentally healing place on the planet. That's what I do on my days off. Also, I'm getting into urbexing, which is exploring abandoned places. That's a new thing.

I went to this abandoned golf course in California. It was really cool. I can't expose the location because then it's not going to be abandoned or underground [ laughs ]. You gotta gatekeep.

Are you ever worried someone is going to come chasing after you? I'd be too nervous.

That's what makes it fun, though. The fact that you're not able to do it makes it so much fun.

You're the tween crush now. Who was your celebrity crush when you were younger?

Oh my goodness. … I have been a Jessica Alba guy for a very, very long time. Through and through. Love you, Jessica. I'm trying to think of my tween crush, though — I was always a big Madelyn Cline guy. I loved Outer Banks . And then Florence Pugh — come on, big shout-out. Come on, y'all know ball. Let's go, Florence Pugh, love you. I love all of them.

What's the last thing you binge-watched?

Coven Academy . We got that encrypted link — [the one that's like] Yo, don't send this to anybody. The FBI shows up to your house if you try and screen-record it . I sat down on my couch and binge-watched it in literally the shortest amount of time you can watch it. I just sat there and banged it out.

Is your email address also a giant watermark across the screen while you watch, like it is for me?

Yes, but honestly, the show is so good I just looked past it the whole time [ laughs ].

What is your go-to late-night snack after a night out? Full order.

Taco Bell — 100%. Taco Bell is banger. My order is the chicken Cantina quesadilla, but that's not in season right now. So the chicken Cantina burrito is what is in season at the moment. And then a Mexican pizza. I feel like that's the vibe. Taco Bell all the way — or, if a Chipotle's open, there we go.

How many tattoos do you have, and what do they mean?

I think I have eight or so. This one right here is [based on] Proverbs 27:21 , which says: "The purity of gold and silver is tested by putting it in the fire, and the purity of the human heart is tested by giving it a little fame." That's a scripture that my grandpa texted me a lot. Then I have "family" in Morse code , matching with my parents. I've got Jesus being taken off the cross on my rib, and then I have a sword on my stomach. My first tattoo was three little crosses on my ankle. I have Joshua 1:9 tattooed on my back. I have my parents' names in a cross on my back, and the coordinates to my favorite surf spot, that's matching with my best friend, on my [back].

Now I just need to get a BMW tattoo somewhere. I'll get it on my lower back. It's gonna be lit.

Does this point in your career feel like something you imagined, or has it surpassed what you pictured?

Honestly, I didn't have any expectations going into this. With anything that I do, I just go in like, all right, what happens, happens. You can't control everything. You can't. The world's going to happen how it's going to happen, and you've just got to be hands-off. That's how you live more peacefully, in my opinion.

So I went hands-off, and it blew the expectations that I didn't have out of the water. I never in a million years would have thought — if I were to tell my 8-year-old self, signing his first Disney contract, that this was going to be the case [11, 12 years] later — I never would have believed it. Mind blown.

This interview has been edited for length and clarity.

articles.title: Festival Breakfast Weekend reúne opções diversas de café da manhã a partir de R$ 39,90 na cidade de SP | G1
articles.standfirst: Breakfast Weekend começa neste sábado (26) e reúne hotéis, cafeterias, padarias e restaurantes com combos e buffets especiais; programação segue até 25 de outubro.
articles.summary: Breakfast Weekend começa neste sábado (26) e reúne hotéis, cafeterias, padarias e restaurantes com combos e buffets especiais; programação segue até 25 de outubro.
articles.body:
Café da Manhã. — Foto: Divulgação/Recanto Cataratas Thermas Resort & Convention.

Ainda não sabe o que fazer neste fim de semana? Uma opção para quem gosta de começar o dia com calma e, de preferência, com uma mesa cheia, é aproveitar a nova edição do Breakfast Weekend , que começa neste sábado (26) em São Paulo .

O festival chega à 10ª edição reunindo hotéis, cafeterias, padarias e restaurantes da capital com menus especiais de café da manhã. A programação vai até 25 de outubro, com opções em formato de combo ou buffet e preços entre R$ 39,90 e R$ 129,90.

A ideia é justamente transformar a primeira refeição do dia em programa: dá para escolher desde uma cafeteria para um café mais rápido até aproveitar o buffet de um hotel sem precisar estar hospedado.

Entre os participantes estão nomes como Hilton Morumbi, Grand Mercure Ibirapuera, InterContinental São Paulo, Novotel Morumbi, Mercure Jardins, Nacional Inn Jaraguá, Canopy by Hilton Jardins, WZ Jardins, INNSiDE by Meliá Iguatemi e Itaim, além de unidades da rede Ibis, Cakess, Sweet & Sugar e Padoca do Jaca.

O festival começou em São Paulo com foco principalmente nos cafés da manhã de hotéis, mas, ao longo das edições, ampliou a lista de participantes e passou a incluir também cafeterias, padarias e restaurantes espalhados pela cidade.

Na prática, é uma chance de conhecer lugares novos ou finalmente experimentar aquele café da manhã de hotel que normalmente passa despercebido por quem mora em São Paulo.

Para quem prefere transformar o café em um programa mais demorado, há opções de buffet. Já quem quer encaixar o passeio antes de seguir para outra atividade pode escolher os estabelecimentos que oferecem combos fechados.

Antes de sair de casa, porém, vale conferir as regras do local escolhido. Horários, cardápios, necessidade de reserva e disponibilidade variam entre os participantes.

📅 Quando? De 26 de setembro a 25 de outubro

📍 Onde? Hotéis, cafeterias, padarias e restaurantes da capital

articles.title: Madrid amanece llena de puertas verdes pintadas: sólo la periodista Gloria Serra puede desvelar la razón
articles.standfirst: La presentadora de ‘Equipo de Investigación’ es protagonista para anunciar la llegada de una nueva película
articles.summary: La presentadora de ‘Equipo de Investigación’ es protagonista para anunciar la llegada de una nueva película
articles.body: Madrid es una de las ciudades más sorprendentes del mundo entero. En la capital de España no paran de suceder cosas. Pues bien, a lo largo de toda la urbe aparecieron, en la mañana de este viernes, 25 de septiembre, pintadas verdes, en forma de puerta, sobre los muros de los domicilios. Gloria Serra, reconocida periodista de nuestro país y presentadora de ‘Equipo de Investigación’, desveló el motivo por el que la ciudad madrileña amaneció de esta manera. Filmin subió un reel en el que Serra era protagonista para investigar el caso de las puertas verdes en Madrid. La periodista se hizo varias preguntas al respecto: “¿Son simples señales? ¿Una puerta a lo desconocido? ¿O una broma del héroe Merlin?”. Las puertas verdes son las entradas a ‘los backrooms’: “Una dimensión desconocida, fuera de nuestro entendimiento. Nosotros intentamos entrar, pero no lo conseguimos. (…) Hemos encontrado muchas por toda la ciudad, cargadas de misterio”. Del mismo modo, la periodista afirmó que había muchas más en la Plaza Mayor, una zona “cinéfila” y de “cine polaco”. Una viandante que entrevista en la pieza afirma que si te acerca a la puerta “escucharás cine polaco en versión original”. “Una versión de Boyero con más ojos”, apuntó otro. Para finalizar, Gloria Serra logró entrar a través de una de las puertas que accedió a la oficina de Filmin. Tras ello, una persona en el interior dijo lo siguiente: “¡Cogedle y ponedle una peli de Tarkovsky!". Lo que se estrena será ‘Backrooms’, la cinta que ya está disponible en la plataforma desde este viernes, 25 de septiembre. “Un umbral que conecta su salón con el mejor cine”, sentenció la presentadora de ‘Equipo de Investigación’.

articles.title: Gisele Bündchen Ended Her Marriage to Tom Brady With Just 3 Words
articles.summary: The former couple, who share two kids, divorced in 2022.
articles.body:
Tom Brady is the subject of an upcoming biography.

In Lars Anderson's Brady: An American Story and the Price of Greatness , a source close to the athlete claims that Gisele Bündchen was the one who ended their marriage.

Brady and Bündchen share two kids and were married for over a decade before divorcing in 2022.

A new book about Tom Brady reveals how his marriage to Gisele Bündchen crumbled. He and the supermodel were together for over a decade before divorcing in 2022.

In Lars Anderson's upcoming biography Brady: An American Story and the Price of Greatness , a source close to the athlete claims that Bündchen was the one who ended their relationship.

"One day, Gisele, who is really into astrology, basically looked into the stars and told Tom, 'We're not compatible,' and just like that, she was done," reads an excerpt published in the Daily Mail .

Anderson writes that Bündchen wanted Brady to retire from football as early as 2017, though his decision to continue playing put strain on their marriage.

According to Anderson, after Brady and the New England Patriots won the 2019 Super Bowl, Bündchen asked: "Would now be the perfect time to retire?"

"Too bad, babe. I'm having too much fun right now," Brady allegedly responded.

Anderson's book also claims that Bündchen wrote Brady a pointed message after the Patriots lost the 2018 Super Bowl.

"She needed him to be present when he was at home, not responding to text messages on his constantly buzzing cell phone or replaying a game in his mind," the author writes. "She needed more help with the kids. She needed the chance to sleep in just a few days a week. She needed more time for her own career."

A friend of Brady's explained how his career might have caused tension within his marriage.

"The guy gets up at the crack of dawn, thinks all day about a game that is foreign to his wife, comes home and is in bed each night by nine," the source said, according to Anderson. "He can't really eat out or go out without causing a scene. Everything he puts in his mouth tastes like shit. The whole lifestyle had to be getting tiresome for Gisele."

After playing with the Patriots for nearly two decades, Brady signed with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in 2020, though he eventually retired in 2023.

Brady and Bündchen share two children—Vivian and Benjamin—while Brady also has a son named Jack from his relationship with Bridget Moynahan. Bündchen has since remarried, tying the knot with jiu-jitsu instructor Joaquim Valente in 2025. The couple welcomed their first child that same year.

articles.title: Oscar Piastri: I need a tow bar to hook onto Mercedes to fight for Baku win
articles.summary: Mercedes' pace in Baku means it's going to be difficult for anyone to compete with George Russell for the win
articles.body:
Having qualified third in Baku after enduring a difficult build-up to the main sessions, Oscar Piastri was happy with the grid position he earned for Formula 1's Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

However, the McLaren driver thinks expecting to go much further in the race is unrealistic, given the gap to Mercedes . While the Australian lost just 0.001s to Charles Leclerc in Q3, the deficit to George Russell was a massive 0.838s.

So when he was asked during the post-qualifying press conference whether he could challenge the Briton in the race, Piastri resorted to sarcasm.

"If he's got a tow bar that I can hook onto the back of, maybe," he smiled. "But yeah, we'll see what we can do."

Given the gap Russell managed to build over his rivals, it's easy to suggest his Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli would have joined him on the front row had he not crashed in Q1 - and at a track where it's relatively easy to overtake, it's not entirely out of the question that Antonelli could still challenge Piastri in the race.

What's more, the McLarens didn't look particularly strong during the practice sessions, which could serve as a hint that the papaya cars may actually be on the defensive rather than the attack on race day. Piastri conceded that the weekend has been difficult for the Woking squad - but qualifying delivered a somewhat unexpected result.

Having not finished higher than sixth in any of the practice sessions, he was even briefly first during Q3, but that wasn't really a representative picture at a track which doesn't particularly suit this year's McLaren car.

On top of that, Piastri experienced a brake issue on Friday morning, forcing his team to use some unusual methods to combat the vibrations - tying some parts together with cable ties in order not to lose track time.

"It's been not an easy weekend, for sure, from a few areas," Piastri said. "You know, we've not been particularly quick. We were also running cable ties on our car through Friday, which is never a great sign. So it's been a little bit of a tricky one for us.

George Russell, Mercedes, Oscar Piastri, McLaren

"In qualifying we found a bit of pace. So, yeah, it's not the first time that's happened to us this year. We seem like we're a bit on the back foot through practice, we come out in qualifying and, yeah, we just find that bit extra.

"I was pretty surprised to see us 1-2 after the first lap of Q3, but unfortunately, we had no hope against George."

Still, the Australian reckons McLaren can fight the other teams on Saturday.

"The Mercedes look incredibly quick here," he said, "but everyone else looks like they're in a similar-ish kind of pack. And our race pace looked pretty good yesterday, to be honest. So I think we can hang on and battle in the pack behind George, and see what lap Kimi starts coming through as well."

Piastri's team-mate Lando Norris will line up fifth on the grid.

articles.title: Pabllo Vittar se move sob rastros de luz na foto da capa do álbum 'Lost in lust' | G1
articles.body:
Capa do álbum 'Lost in lust', de Pabllo Vittar — Foto: Hick Duarte com arte gráfica de Lucasphobia

♬ Pabllo Vittar se move sob rastros de luz na foto exposta na capa do sétimo álbum de estúdio da artista, “Lost in lust”. Programado para ser lançado na próxima quinta-feira, 1º de outubro, o álbum “Lost in lust” mostra Pabllo na capa em foto feita por Hick Duarte e enquadrada na arte gráfica criada por Lucasphobia.

Para chegar à imagem meio onírica da capa, a equipe de criação da artista optou por fotografar a cantora sob luz etérea e em clima sensual, para tentar traduzir na imagem o tom do álbum em que Pabllo Vittar ambienta 12 músicas – cantadas em inglês e/ou espanhol – em atmosfera eletrônica. Uma das referências visuais da capa foi a obra do fotógrafo italiano de moda Paolo Roversi.

Conceitualmente, o álbum “Lost in lust” – cujo título significa “Perdido na luxúria”, em bom português – é caracterizado como “uma jornada pelo desejo, pelo excesso, pela intimidade e pelo espaço indefinido entre o prazer e a obsessão”.

Ao longo das 12 faixas do álbum, a artista faz feat com o cantor venezuelano La Cruz em “Big bang”, se une ao astro italiano Mahmood em “Polizia”, divide o canto de “Body type” com Urias e traz a rapper porto-riquenha Villano Antillano em “Rockstar”.

“Alone”, “Attention”, “Bad good”, “Better than a feeling”, “Carnaval”, “Friend with...”, “Future” e “Skin” são as outras oito músicas que completam a tracklist do álbum “Lost in lust”.

articles.title: 'The Paradise' box office collection day 2: Nani, Kayadu Lohar film earns Rs 98.50 cr worldwide; India gross reaches Rs 72.50 cr
articles.summary: Nani's action thriller 'The Paradise' has recorded a worldwide gross of Rs 98.50 cr.
articles.body: Nani's action thriller 'The Paradise' has recorded a worldwide gross of Rs 98.50 cr. The figure comes after the film's first two days of theatrical release. Its India gross collection currently stands at Rs 72.50 cr.The movie has also earned Rs 26.00 cr from overseas markets. According to Sacnilk, its India net collection has reached Rs 61.15 cr. The figures have been recorded across 17,681 shows.'The Paradise' Day 0 and Day 1 collectionThe movie began its box office journey on September 23, 2026. On Day 0, which fell on a Wednesday, 'The Paradise' collected Rs 13.95 cr in gross earnings. Its India net collection stood at Rs 11.60 cr. The film was screened across 900 shows that day. It recorded an occupancy rate of 79.0%.On September 24, the movie witnessed a major jump in its collections. The first Thursday brought in Rs 40.95 cr in gross earnings. The India net collection for the day stood at Rs 34.65 cr. The movie had 9,732 shows on Day 1. Its reported occupancy stood at 49.3%.'The Paradise' Day 2 box office reportOn Friday, September 25, 'The Paradise' collected Rs 17.60 cr in gross earnings. The India net collection for Day 2 stood at Rs 14.90 cr. The film recorded 7,049 shows on its second day. Its occupancy for the day was 32.8%.With the latest figures, the movie's overall India net collection has reached Rs 61.15 cr. Its India gross total stands at Rs 72.50 cr.Region-wise India collection of 'The Paradise'Andhra Pradesh and Telangana have contributed the largest share of the movie's India gross. The region has recorded Rs 56.25 cr across the three reported days. Karnataka has contributed Rs 7.35 cr. The rest of India has added Rs 5.33 cr. Tamil Nadu has recorded Rs 3.00 cr, while Kerala has contributed Rs 57 lakhs.On Day 0, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana contributed Rs 11.00 cr. Tamil Nadu recorded Rs 80 lakhs, while Karnataka added Rs 2.05 cr. Kerala contributed Rs 7 lakhs and the rest of India Rs 3 lakhs.On Day 1, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana collected Rs 31.50 cr. Tamil Nadu contributed Rs 1.75 cr, while Karnataka added Rs 4.00 cr. Kerala recorded Rs 0.40 cr and the rest of India contributed Rs 3.30 cr.On Day 2, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana contributed Rs 13.75 cr. Tamil Nadu recorded Rs 0.45 cr and Karnataka Rs 1.30 cr. Kerala added Rs 10 lakhs, while the rest of India contributed Rs 2.00 cr.Nani addresses audience response to 'The Paradise'Nani has acknowledged the response to 'The Paradise' through his official social media account. The actor said he had seen the reactions and responses from viewers.Nani wrote, “I have seen all your reactions and responses. I’ve received all your love and equally enjoyed your hilarious trolls. I’m heartwarmed by the way the audience have owned the film, and also learnt from the flaws that critics and reviewers have pointed out.”Directed by Srikanth Odela, 'The Paradise' features Nani, Mohan Babu, Sonali Kulkarni, Kayadu Lohar, Raghav Juyal, Sampoornesh Babu and Easwari Rao. Keerthy Suresh appears in a cameo role in the action thriller. Nani's previous film was 'Hit 3'. articles.title: Quote of the day by Sylvester Stallone: ‘We can’t succeed in everything. Most times, we lose. But the few times we do win, we have to make sure they were the important battles,’ a powerful life lesson explaining that winning the right fight matters more than winning all of them
articles.summary: Explore Sylvester Stallone's impactful quote on success, failure, and the importance of choosing the right battles in life. Discover how his journey from struggle to stardom encapsulates this message.
articles.body: Failure is something almost everyone experiences, but learning what is worth fighting for can change the way we look at it. Sylvester Stallone once spoke about this while reflecting on life, success and the legacy of his most famous character, Rocky Balboa. His words offer a simple idea: we may not win every battle, but the ones that truly matter deserve our effort.Today’s quote of the day by Sylvester Stallone reads: “I’m a big believer that, in life, we can’t succeed in everything. Most times, we lose. But the few times we do win, we have to make sure they were the important battles.”What does the quote by Sylvester Stallone mean?The actor expressed these thoughts in a 2006 interview with Total Film when explaining why he wanted Rocky to be remembered for the inspiration the character gave people. Stallone’s words seem to suggest that success does not have to be measured by winning every argument, competition or challenge. Some fights aren't worth wearing ourselves out over.Disappointments are in life. Plans go awry, opportunities are lost, and sometimes even our best efforts do not give us the result we hoped for. Stallone’s argument is that failure is not necessarily a failure in life. The key thing is knowing where to put our energy.The second part of his thought is especially important. If there are only a few moments when everything falls into place, those moments should involve things that genuinely matter to us. That could mean a career goal, a relationship, family, personal growth or a dream that we have refused to give up on.Why does his message still matter today?Modern life can make success look like a competition that never ends. One person is announcing a new job, another is celebrating an award, while someone else is sharing a new relationship, business achievement or personal milestone.Also, it is important to realise that not every setback needs to stay on our mind, and not every argument is worth spending our energy on. Sometimes, knowing what to leave behind can be just as important as knowing what to fight for. Sometimes, moving forward means knowing what to let go of and where to put your energy. Sometimes walking away from something is also a form of strength.His words also encourage people to think about priorities. Instead of trying to win everywhere, it may be more meaningful to protect the relationships, ambitions and values that matter most.Sylvester Stallone’s early lifeBorn on July 6, 1946, in New York City, Stallone did not enter Hollywood with an easy path to success. A medical complication at the time of his birth left Stallone with partial paralysis affecting some facial muscles. That condition became part of Stallone's distinctive screen presence, from the way he spoke to the expressions he made while acting.His journey in Hollywood was anything but smooth. Long before audiences knew him as an action star, Stallone took whatever small acting work he could find. Money was often tight, and finding steady work was not easy.With acting opportunities limited, he started putting more time into writing. It was a decision that eventually opened a completely different door for him. The story he wrote would go on to change the course of his career.Sylvester Stallone’s rise to fameEverything changed for Stallone when 'Rocky' arrived in 1976. He had written the screenplay and also played the lead, and the film quickly turned into a major success. It also earned him Academy Award nominations for his performance as well as his writing.Ultimately, “Rocky Balboa” was far more than a character in a boxing movie. His story touched people's hearts because it's about getting back up when things go wrong and continuing to believe in yourself. Stallone returned to the role over the years, with 'Rocky Balboa' bringing him back to the character in 2006.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: 'Avengers Endgame: Encore' box office collection Day 1: Marvel re-release opens to Rs 7.25 crore in India; worldwide total hits USD 2.8 billion
articles.summary: 'Avengers Endgame: Encore' has made a strong start at the Indian box office.
articles.body: 'Avengers Endgame: Encore' has made a strong start at the Indian box office. The film that is a re-release of the 2019 blockbuster 'Avengers: Endgame', has according to early estimates, scored a good opening at the box office.'Avengers Endgame: Encore' box office collection Day 1According to sacnilk, the film has earned an estimated Rs 7.25 crore nett on its opening day. The Marvel blockbuster, which returned to cinemas nationwide seven years after its original release, recorded the collection across 3,635 shows, taking its total India gross to an estimated Rs 8.68 crore.The original English version of the film accounted for the bulk of the opening-day business, earning an estimated Rs 5.25 crore. The Hindi version followed with around Rs 1.25 crore, while the Tamil and Telugu dubbed versions contributed approximately Rs 30 lakh and Rs 45 lakh, respectively.The film recorded an overall occupancy of 24.52% on Friday, with the night shows witnessing the highest footfalls.'Avengers Endgame: Encore' opens ahead of early estimatesThe opening-day business is broadly in line with early box office projections, which had estimated that the re-release could earn around Rs 6 crore on its first day. The film had also recorded advance bookings worth approximately Rs 17 crore.Considering that 'Endgame: Encore' is a re-release, its opening has given the film a considerable head start. With the weekend ahead and the buzz around the Avengers franchise continuing to build, the film could emerge as one of the biggest re-releases in India.With its Day 1 business crossing the Rs 7 crore net mark, 'Endgame: Encore' has already registered one of the top five openings for a re-release in India. It is also the only Hollywood title currently in the top bracket, behind the re-release of 'Baahubali: The Epic', which opened to an estimated Rs 19 crore. The film will now look to challenge the existing top re-release performers, including 'Sanam Teri Kasam' (Rs 41 crore), 'Tumbbad' (Rs 40 crore), 'Ghilli' (Rs 26.25 crore) and 'Sholay' (Rs 11 crore).'Avengers: Endgame' crosses USD 2.8 billion globallyOn the global front, 'Avengers: Endgame' has finally crossed the $2.8 billion mark at the worldwide box office, seven years after its original release.As per the Hollywood reporter, the re-release earned USD 3.8 million from Thursday previews, with the studio projecting that its return could gross around USD 25 million domestically and another USD 25 million-USD 30 million from international markets.During its original theatrical run in April 2019, 'Avengers: Endgame' opened to a record-setting USD 1.2 billion globally in its first weekend. The film went on to become one of the highest-grossing movies of all time, eventually accumulating around USD 2.7 billion worldwide during its initial run.Can 'Avengers' break 'Avatar' record?The film is still USD 100 million away from hitting the USD 2.9 billion mark, to officially dethrone 'Avatar' as the highest-grossing film of all time (with re-releases).The Encore re-release also includes an exclusive look at Marvel Studios’ upcoming 'Avengers: Doomsday', which is scheduled to hit theatres on December 18.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: When Mushtaq Khan recalled Salman Khan's dating days, 'Welcome' actor said, 'Iss tarah ki baatein humne kabhi kari bhi nahi'
articles.summary: Mushtaq Khan passed away on Thursday evening at the age of 62. He had been battling cancer for a prolonged period.
articles.body: Mushtaq Khan passed away on Thursday evening at the age of 62. He had been battling cancer for a prolonged period. The veteran actor worked across several Hindi films and television shows during his career. His performance as Ballu in 'Welcome' remains among his best-known roles. The 2007 film was directed by Anees Bazmee. It featured Akshay Kumar, Katrina Kaif, Nana Patekar and Anil Kapoor in prominent roles.Mushtaq Khan had once shared an anecdote involving Salman Khan during the making of 'Welcome,' the movie that featured Katrina Kaif in the lead. The actor also spoke about questions surrounding Salman Khan's relationships.When Mushtaq Khan was asked about Salman Khan's dating daysIn an old interview with Filmymantra, Mushtaq Khan was asked about Salman Khan's dating life. He was specifically questioned about whether Sangeeta Bijlani had visited Salman Khan on a film set. The actor was also asked whether Salman Khan had visited Sangeeta Bijlani during shoots. Mushtaq Khan said such personal matters were not topics of discussion among them.He responded, "Iss tarah ki baatein humne kabhi kari bhi nahi aur kabhi poochha bhi nahi (We have never even discussed such things, nor have we ever asked about them).”Mushtaq Khan then recalled an occasion involving Salman Khan during the Dubai schedule of 'Welcome'. He said, “I have never seen Sangeeta ji come to the set to meet him, but once, when we were shooting the film 'Welcome' in Dubai, Salman came to the hotel there."Anupam Kher remembers Mushtaq KhanFollowing Mushtaq Khan's demise, several members of the film industry shared tributes. Anupam Kher posted a video remembering his professional association with the late actor.Anupam Kher recalled a period when the two actors worked together on several projects. He mentioned films associated with Mahesh Bhatt and Satish Kaushik.“There was a time when we worked together on a lot of films - Mahesh Bhatt's films, Satish Kaushik's films, and many others. Then we walked on our own paths. But I will always remember the days I spent with him."Anupam Kher also remembered Mushtaq Khan's personality and sense of humour. He added, "Mr Mushtaq was a very simple man. He had a great sense of humour. And I have never seen him angry."Suniel Shetty and Paresh Rawal pay tributeSuniel Shetty also expressed his grief after Mushtaq Khan's death. The actor remembered the veteran performer through a message on social media.Suniel Shetty wrote, "This one hurts. Some people leave behind memories that will always make you smile. My heartfelt condolences to the family. Rest in peace." Paresh Rawal also paid tribute to Mushtaq Khan. He remembered the late actor for his personality and his work as a performer.Paresh Rawal wrote, "Mushtaq Khan. Loving human being and an exciting actor. REST IN PEACE."Mushtaq Khan's career spanned films and television. His supporting performances made him a familiar face among Hindi cinema audiences.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. Download the TOI app.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: 'Vvan: Force of the Forrest' box office collection day 1: Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia's film opens with Rs 8.00 cr
articles.summary: 'Vvan: Force of the Forest ', starring Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia, opened in theatres on September 25, 2026.
articles.body: 'Vvan: Force of the Forest ', starring Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia, opened in theatres on September 25, 2026. The fantasy thriller takes place in an ancestral village in Bihar. The film combines folklore, supernatural forces and a conflict surrounding a forbidden forest.'Vvan: Force of the Forrest' collects Rs 8.00 crAccording to Sacnilk, 'Vvan: Force of the Forrest' earned Rs 8.00 cr in India net on Day 1. The collection came from 6,746 shows across the country. The film's India gross collection stood at Rs 9.60 cr on its opening day.The Day 1 figures also bring the film's total India net collection to Rs 8.00 cr. The opening-day numbers were recorded on Friday, September 25, 2026.The Vvan Movie ReviewFilm records 28.25% overall occupancyThe Hindi 2D version of 'Vvan: Force of the Forrest' registered 28.25% overall occupancy on Day 1. The night shows recorded the highest occupancy during the opening day. Night screenings registered 41.46% occupancy. Evening shows recorded 26.08%, while afternoon screenings registered 24.00%. Morning shows recorded 12.23% occupancy.The film had 6,746 shows across the country on its first day. Its India net collection stood at Rs 8.00 cr at the end of Day 1.Sidharth Malhotra plays RishiSidharth Malhotra plays Rishi, a rational man raised in an urban setting. He travels back to his ancestral village in Bihar with his wife Mamta. Tamannaah Bhatia plays Mamta in the film.Rishi returns to sell the land he inherited from his family. His visit also coincides with Chhath Puja celebrations. However, his plans change after he encounters the village's beliefs surrounding a forbidden forest. The villagers have strict warnings about the forest. Nobody is permitted to enter it after sunset. Rishi does not accept their beliefs and instead supports Deepak, played by Sunil Grover. Deepak wants to clear a section of the forest to improve connectivity.Rishi awakens an ancient supernatural forceRishi eventually enters the forbidden forest despite the warnings. During his visit, he breaks an ancient seal. This action unleashes a supernatural force that challenges his understanding of reality. The story places Rishi in a conflict involving greed, development and supernatural powers. He must also confront the ancient folklore surrounding Vandevi and the forest.The central premise follows Rishi as he awakens a divine goddess. He then finds himself facing forces that exist beyond conventional logic. His journey turns him into an unlikely saviour who must protect the villagers from annihilation.Deepak Kumar Mishra and Arunabh Kumar direct the film'Vvan: Force of the Forrest' has been directed by Deepak Kumar Mishra and Arunabh Kumar. The film presents a rational urban man confronting supernatural forces after challenging the traditions of his ancestral village.ETimes' review of the film reads, "The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest has the ingredients of a more layered fantasy thriller but never brings them together consistently. Its atmosphere, visual ambition and intriguing premise work in its favour, while rushed character development and an increasingly conventional supernatural conflict limit its impact. What could have been a nuanced tale about faith, greed, development and the consequences of disturbing nature instead becomes a moderately engaging supernatural adventure that only partially fulfils the potential of its premise."DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources. All figures are approximate unless explicitly mentioned, offering a fair representation of the movie's box office performance. These totals may change as official studio data is updated or as additional international market reports are finalized. articles.title: Dolly Parton's Young cancer survivor fan celebrates ‘9 to 5 Day’ at the hospital
articles.summary: Over the years, Dolly Parton invested in a lot of endeavours and believed in giving back to the community.
articles.body: Over the years, Dolly Parton invested in a lot of endeavours and believed in giving back to the community. Earlier this year, she donated a generous amount to a children’s hospital in Knoxville, which was renamed the Dolly Parton Children's Hospital in February 2026, only a few months before her passing.In a recent announcement, the children’s hospital revealed plans to hold a ‘9 to 5’ party to honour Dolly Parton’s commitment to charitable causes and her significant impact on countless individuals. At the centre of the celebration was 9-year-old Hattie Halter, a longtime fan of Parton and a patient at the hospital.Dolly Parton Children's Hospital to honour her legacy with a partyThe hospital revealed that they would hold a ‘9 to 5’ theme party to honour Parton’s legacy, and Halter, who was diagnosed with cancer when she was only nine months old, also attended the celebration. While talking to PEOPLE, her mother, Mellisa Halter, shared how her entire family will be there.She added, "I and her dad, her two brothers, and Hattie, we’re all going to be there bright and early. Being a part of anything that has to do with Dolly where she gets to talk to people about her, she’s just so excited.” She also recalled the time when her daughter had been diagnosed with leukemia and how harrowing the entire experience was for their family.She recalled, “It’s miserable and scary. You basically have to start treating the cancer as soon as possible so you really don’t have any time to process or think it through. It’s just a very scary thing to go from hoping they crawl and talk soon to, "Oh my gosh, is this going to kill my kid?" It’s something the little cute ‘how to prepare to be a mom’ books don’t necessarily warn you about.”Hattie Halter is a big fan of Dolly PartonHer mother also revealed that she has been a big fan of Parton and her music for years now, adding, “She loves her music, just her accent and the way she sings. And the fact that we have Dollywood here and she sees her everywhere in Tennessee, she just likes to dance and shimmy to her music.”Melissa further added, “I honestly feel like the way she carried herself—she exuded that kind of sunshine and happiness and wanting to help others—is what stuck out too, and Hattie just was attracted to that.”Days after the singer’s passing, the hospital shared a video of their patients and their parents sharing their experiences at the hospital and how they were able to overcome their diseases while remembering Parton. The caption under the post read, “Our patients and families express our feelings best. Dolly’s love and compassion will continue as we carry her light forward for generations to come. Thank you, Dolly.”About Dolly PartonThe country singer left for her heavenly abode on August 25 after a brief battle with cancer. The news of her passing was shared by her nephew, Bryan Seaver, in a video that was circulated on all of her social media accounts. The singer had been admitted to a cancer facility a few days before her passing. She had also chosen not to share her diagnosis with the world until after her demise.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Kris Jenner takes off USD 13.5 million ‘KUWTK’ Hidden Hills mansion off the market reportedly after having ‘second thoughts'
articles.summary: Around a year ago, reports confirmed that Kris Jenner had decided to put the iconic ‘Keeping Up With The Kardashians’ mansion on the market.
articles.body: Around a year ago, reports confirmed that Kris Jenner had decided to put the iconic ‘Keeping Up With The Kardashians’ mansion on the market. The online personality had been ready to part ways with the beloved house that appeared in most of the episodes of ‘Keeping Up With The Kardashians ’; however, new reports indicate Jenner is planning on holding on to the mansion for the time being.Kris Jenner pulls the ‘KUWTK’ house from the marketJenner has officially pulled the iconic mansion where most of the episodes of ‘KUWTK’ were filmed off the market. The news comes after the house had been up for sale for more than a year. ELLE Decor reported the news and shared that the mansion, which had earlier been listed for USD 13.5 million, has officially been put on hold, according to property records.Zillow reported that the house was first bought for USD 4 million in 2010 and has been under Jenner’s ownership for the past 16 years. Earlier this year, in May, the home had been briefly removed from the listing; however, she soon put it back up on the market for the same asking price. However, four months later, it has been confirmed yet again that the reality show house is no longer on the market.In another report shared by TMZ, Jenner may have had second thoughts about the home. A statement from the report read, "Kris hesitated to move forward... not because of a lack of interest, but because she started reconsidering the bigger picture.”More about the iconic ‘Keeping Up with the Kardashians’ houseThe property is located in Hidden Hills and spans 8,860 square feet. The mansion features around 6 bedrooms and 8 bathrooms, along with the famous black-and-white checkered foyer with a double staircase that has appeared in many episodes. Along with this, the home also features a massive chef’s kitchen covered in white, along with a large dining table and clear, cushioned chairs for the entire family.Last year, when she first listed the property on the market, the Jenner family matriarch revealed that she was ready for the house to move on to its next chapter. While talking to The New York Times then, she mentioned, “I’ve shared so many unforgettable memories in this incredible home with my family, and I’m excited to see it start a new chapter with its next owners.” She also revealed during the interview that she had spent millions of dollars on the house over the years on renovations and other amenities.During the season 7 premiere of the ‘KUWTK’ OTT spin-off show, ‘The Kardashians,' the Jenner family looked back at their time in the house, where both Kylie and Kendall spent their growing years. When asked why she was selling the house, Kris simply replied, “Cash, of course.” The family then decided that holding one last family dinner in the house would be a nice memory for all of them to share.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: ‘Princess Diaries’ star Heather Matarazzo says she risks losing her health insurance because of no work: ‘I am literally in the same boat…’
articles.summary: Heather Matarazzo, known for 'Princess Diaries,' reveals the risk of losing her SAG-AFTRA health insurance due to lack of work. Discover the challenges actors face within the industry and the rising income thresholds for health benefits.
articles.body: Heather Matarazzo recently revealed that she needs work or else she may soon lose her health insurance under SAG-AFTRA. The organisation requires actors to earn a minimum wage to qualify for health benefits. The 'Princess Diaries' star, who played Lilly Moscovitz in the film, revealed that she needs work to qualify.‘Princess Diaries’ star Heather Matarazzo says she may lose her health insurance without workIn a comment she posted recently, the ‘Princess Diaries’ star revealed that she is at risk of losing her health benefits. Earlier, Jack Haven, star of ‘Atypical’ and ‘I Saw The TV Glow,’ recently went viral for sharing their plight on social media, stating they needed work soon and needed USD 4000 to prevent their SAG-AFTRA health insurance under SAG-AFTRA from lapsing.While replying to an account that had shared the news about Haven’s plight, Heather admitted that she is going through the same thing. She posted, “I am literally in the same boat right now. Lots of my fellow actors are. I remember a time when we didn’t have to earn a minimum to qualify for insurance. Glad to see that Jack has gotten an offer that will let them qualify for 2027.”Heather last appeared in the 2025 film ‘Paper Tiger.' Other than that, she also had a recurring role in the OTT series 'Wednesday' alongside Jenna Ortega. She played the role of Judi Spannagel, the cheerful yet sinister executive assistant to Dr Rachael Fairburn at the Willow Hill Psychiatric Facility in season two of the hit show. Some of her other recent works also include ‘Welcome to the Dollhouse,' ‘The Devil’s Advocate,' and ‘Scream 3.' Other than that, ‘Princess Diaries 3’ is confirmed to be in development; however, it has not been confirmed who all from the original cast will be returning for the movie alongside Anne Hathaway.Jack Haven admits they got a lot of offersSoon after their video went viral online, Haven shared another video on their YouTube channel confirming that they received many work offers after their appeal went viral. The actor, who recently appeared in ‘Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma,' shared, “I got a lot of offers. So, thank you, guys. Thank you for your love and your kindness. I really feel overwhelmed. My manager, Adam, said it was like, It’s a Wonderful Life. I feel kind of crazy, too, because I didn’t really expect [this]. I didn’t expect this many people to see the video.”According to guidelines shared on SAG-AFTRA’s official website, this year, actors qualifying for health benefits under the guild were required to earn a minimum of USD 28,090 for health insurance. It has also been confirmed that the overall amount is going to rise to a total of USD 28,933 from next year onwards. The USD 900 rise will be added to the total annual earnings up until 2030, according to the website.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.body: YouTube sensation MrBeast sparked fan frenzy among Indian fans after he was spotted in Agra, where he visited the Taj Mahal with his wife and team. His India visit comes amid speculation that the content creator could be making a special appearance as part of the promotional campaign for Nitesh Tiwari’s highly anticipated film 'Ramayana'.MrBeast to join 'Ramayana' promotions?According to reports, MrBeast is expected to participate in a special showcase for the Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi-starrer on September 26. articles.title: Cameron Douglas celebrates his ‘family’ Michael Douglas, Catherine Zeta-Jones on their b’days
articles.summary: Actor Cameron Douglas showered love on his father Michael Douglas and stepmother Catherine Zeta-Jones on their birthdays, calling the couple two of the
articles.body: Actor Cameron Douglas showered love on his father Michael Douglas and stepmother Catherine Zeta-Jones on their birthdays, calling the couple two of the “most dynamic and lovely” people he knows and celebrating them as family.Cameron, who is the son of Michael Douglas and Diandra Morrell Luker, took to Instagram to share a picture of his father and Zeta-Jones.“Happy Happy Birthday to two of the most dynamic and lovely individuals I know, whom I have the great pleasure of calling Family,” Cameron wrote as the caption.Cameron added: “Dad, I Love you to pieces here’s to many more fabulous trips around the sun with your beautiful and beloved wife…Catherine you are the best and I Love you Happiest of Birthdays guys @catherinezetajones @michaelkirkdouglas.”Cameron has appeared in several films, among them Jackie Chan's Mr. Nice Guy in 1997, It Runs in the Family, National Lampoon's Adam & Eve and Loaded. It Runs in the Family featured three generations of the Douglas family, as it also starred his father, Michael, and paternal grandparents, Kirk and Diana.It was in 1999, when Michael Douglas and Zeta-Jones started dating. They got married a year later in 2000. The couple have two children, son Dylan Michael and daughter Carys Zeta.Talking about the actress, Zeta-Jones im February revealed that she’s back in the world of the macabre as she resumes work on the third season of the hit series Wednesday.The Oscar-winning actress, who essays the enigmatic Morticia Addams in the show, shared a glimpse from the sets on Instagram, revealing that filming for Season 3 is underway.“Working away on Season 3 of @wednesdaynetflix Having a grave old time,” she wrote as the caption, adding her signature dark humour to the update.Wednesday is based on the character Wednesday Addams by Charles Addams. It stars Jenna Ortega as the titular character, with Luis Guzman and Catherine Zeta-Jones portraying her parents in the series.Meanwhile, Michael Douglas has enjoyed a decades-long career in the film industry. He is popularly known for playing Gordon Gekko in Oliver Stone's Wall Street.The actor has given out some of his best performances in projects such as The China Syndrome, Romancing the Stone, The Jewel of the Nile, Fatal Attraction, The War of the Roses, Basic Instinct, Falling Down, The American President, The Game, Traffic, Wonder Boys, and Solitary Man.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more.
